task.title: P6-136: Escape SQL wildcards in set search and sort released_at by date, not text alias
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-136. Size: S. Specs: specs/catalog-search.md.

**The set search treats `%` and `_` as SQL wildcards, and sorts on a text alias rather than the date column** (was `P6-036b` + `P6-036c`). `hosted.rs:332-345` interpolates the term into `ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'` with no escaping — parameterized, so not injection, just wrong-looking results. And `ORDER BY released_at` binds to the `released_at::text AS released_at` **output alias**, so the sort is lexicographic on text — correct only because ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` collates like the date, and a `DateStyle` change would silently reorder the picker.
